title: The light we carry
mood: Reflective and intimate, growing into warm hope
performance: Slow expressive storytelling, sustained phrases and natural breaths
instruments: Fingerpicked acoustic guitar, felt piano, upright bass, brushed drums, strings, lyrical electric guitar
production: Warm natural room ambience and a wide, gentle final chorus
global_metadata: A complete five-minute song with three full verses, repeated choruses, a bridge, instrumental solo and a lingering outro. Preserve all sung words and let the arrangement develop patiently.

sections.name: intro
sections.direction: Eight bars of fingerpicked guitar and soft piano; spacious, unhurried opening.

sections.name: verse 1
sections.lyrics:
I left the porch light burning in the rain
And took the road that bends around the bay
The houses held their windows to the dawn
While every restless shadow slipped away
I carried all the words I could not say
Like little stones inside a borrowed coat
The river took the silence from my hands
And gave me back a song I used to know
sections.direction: Sing each line slowly over two bars; do not rush the phrasing. Gradually add warm bass and brushed drums.

sections.name: chorus
sections.lyrics:
We are the light we carry through the weather
We are the hands that hold against the cold
We are the threads that find their way together
A little braver as the years unfold
Leave a little room for all the wonder
Leave a little time to lose the road
Somewhere in the quiet after thunder
There is still a place that we call home
sections.direction: Open into a broad, spacious chorus with strings and gentle backing harmonies. Let every line breathe.

sections.name: verse 2
sections.lyrics:
The station clock was running half an hour
Behind the people waiting for a train
A woman held a paper full of flowers
And smiled as sunlight found the windowpane
I thought about the miles we put between us
The letters folded carefully away
And all the ordinary things that teach us
There is another way to face the day

sections.name: bridge
sections.lyrics:
No promise keeps the winter from the doorway
No map can show us every turning tide
But I can meet you halfway in the morning
And walk the unfamiliar at your side
If all we have is one more honest moment
If all we know is how to start again
Then let us leave the broken gate wide open
And listen to the rhythm of the rain
sections.direction: Pull back to piano and lead voice, then rebuild with swelling strings.

sections.name: solo
sections.direction: Sixteen bars of lyrical electric guitar over the chorus harmony.

sections.name: verse 3
sections.lyrics:
At evening I returned along the water
The same old road beneath a different sky
The boats were coming home across the harbour
And gulls were drawing circles way up high
Your message waited softly in my pocket
No grand reply was needed after all
I watched the first star flicker into waking
And found the words to finally make the call
